summary: Iteration 8 — Full backend + frontend testing on ADFR brand preview. 100% pass. Backend: 8/8 pytest (/api/track + source coercion, /api/track/stats auth guard, days clamp 1..90, source filter sos vs adfr vs all, /api/callback with source=sos appearing in /api/callbacks?scope=today). Frontend ADFR: title='ADFR — Dépannage & Remorquage Île-de-France 24/7', html[data-brand]='adfr', canonical=https://adfr-depannage.fr/, body bg rgb(5,11,20), hero-call-button bg rgb(227,6,19), phone 01 85 80 00 61 present, no 'SOS Dépannage' visible text. 8 new city routes (/depannage-fontenay-sous-bois, -rosny-sous-bois, -gagny, -bondy, -noisy-le-sec, -le-raincy, -nogent-sur-marne, -neuilly-sur-marne) all return 200 with H1 containing the city name. Rosny mentions 'Rosny', Le Raincy mentions 'Thiers', both with FAQ + form. Admin: login with prefilled email + password works, clicks-stats block visible with totals (call/whatsapp/form), clicks-range-7 produces 7 rows, clicks-source-sos reduces totals (13→2 call, 12→1 wa) ≤ ALL, clicks-source-all restores. Callback cards show callback-source-<id> badges (both ADFR and SOS visible, including the TEST_SOS User created via backend). admin-refresh works without errors. Home callback form submits successfully and shows 'C'est reçu !' confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~550 lines, borderline on size limit; still manageable but can be split (auth / email / api) if it grows further.
track_stats source filter correctly treats legacy events without source as 'adfr' (via $in [adfr, null]) — good.
No input validation on scope query param of /api/callbacks (any value other than 'today' returns all) — minor, acceptable since behind admin cookie.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a few TEST_SOS User / TEST_HACK User callbacks and some track events (call/whatsapp with source=sos & coerced 'hack') in the preview DB — safe to keep as per request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview is REACT_APP_BRAND=adfr by default. SOS brand not tested here. Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. BRAND_NAMES dict in server.py bundle may contain the string 'SOS Dépannage' in JS source, but it is NOT in visible page text on ADFR brand.
